# Setting a Cookie

#### Course: JavaScript in Browser

## Setting a Cookie

Suppose your webpage has a toggle switch for light and dark themes.

```html
1<body>
2
3    <div class="theme-switch">
4        <input type="checkbox" id="theme-toggle" onchange="toggleTheme()">
5        <label for="theme-toggle" class="slider"></label>
6    </div>
7</body>
```

```css
1body {
2            padding: 20px;
3            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
4            transition: background-color 0.3s, color 0.3s;
5            display: flex;
6            justify-content: center;
7            align-items: center;
8            height: 100vh;
9            margin: 0;
10            background-color: #f4f4f4; /* Light grey background */
11            color: #333; /* Dark text */
12        }
13 
14        .theme-switch {
15            position: relative;
16            width: 80px; /* Width of the switch */
17            height: 40px; /* Height of the switch */
18            margin-top: 20px;
19        }
20 
21        .theme-switch input {
22            opacity: 1;
23            width: 0;
24            height: 0;
25        }
26 
27        .slider {
28            position: absolute;
29            cursor: pointer;
30            top: 0;
31            left: 0;
32            right: 0;
33            bottom: 0;
34            background-color: #ccc;
35            transition: .4s;
36            border-radius: 25px;
37        }
38 
39        .slider:before {
40            position: absolute;
41            content: "";
42            height: 34px; /* Height of the slider circle */
43            width: 34px; /* Width of the slider circle */
44            left: 3px;
45            bottom: 3px;
46            background-color: white;
47            transition: .4s;
48            border-radius: 50%;
49        }
50 
51        input:checked + .slider {
52            background-color: #2196F3;
53        }
54 
55        input:checked + .slider:before {
56            transform: translateX(38px);
57        }
```

```javascript
1// Set cookie to save dark theme preference until 31st dec, 2026
2document.cookie = "theme=dark; path=/; expires=Fri, 31 Dec 2026 23:59:59 UTC";
3
4// Set cookie to save light theme preference until 31st dec, 2026
5document.cookie = "theme=light; path=/; expires=Fri, 31 Dec 2026 23:59:59 UTC";
```

Run the above code and click the slider.

When the webpage theme changes, document.cookie updates to store the corresponding theme preference as a cookie. Here,

- theme=dark or theme=light: Stores the theme preference.
- path=/: Makes the cookie available across the entire site.
- expires=Fri, 31 Dec 2026 23:59:59 UTC: Ensures the cookie lasts until the specified date.
